Atrapa a su presa desplegando las ramas de sus brazos, que no le importa perder ante depredadores. Cuando llega el calor, se cubre por completo con sus lianas y no se le pueden ver ni los ojos. Se ha descubierto recientemente que los dos brazos que estira a voluntad son en realidad lianas enredadas entre sí. Las lianas le crecen más rápidamente si vive en regiones cálidas. Cuando alcanzan cierta longitud, se las corta.

name: Electivire
description:
Electivire is known as "Thunderbolt Pokémon", predominantly yellow in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Electivire first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the humanshape egg groups.

As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns. It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power. Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage. The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe. It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant. When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around. It grips its tail, which spews electricity, and then beats down opponents with the power of its electrified fist. A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year. The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling. In terms of electrical-energy output, Electivire is one of the best among all Electric Pokémon. It discharges high-voltage currents from its tails.
description_es:
Electivire es conocido como "Pokémon Rayo", de color predominantemente amarillo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Electivire apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo humanshape.

Al almacenar mucha electricidad, desprende chispas de una claridad increíble entre sus dos cuernos. Toca a su enemigo con las puntas de sus dos colas y le suelta una descarga de más de 20 000 voltios. Toca a su enemigo con la punta de sus colas y le suelta una descarga de alta tensión que lo deja achicharrado al instante. Al exaltarse, se golpea con ímpetu el pecho. Cada vez que lo hace saltan chispas y un trueno resuena por la zona. Agarra sus colas para electrificar los puños y luego soltar puñetazos devastadores. La electricidad que genera un solo Electivire es suficiente para cubrir la demanda energética de los edificios de una metrópoli durante un año. La cantidad de electricidad que genera es proporcional a su pulso. Al enzarzarse en combate, su voltaje aumenta drásticamente. Es de los Pokémon de tipo Eléctrico que más electricidad producen. Genera una corriente de alta tensión desde las puntas de las colas.

name: Magmortar
description:
Magmortar is known as "Blast Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Magmortar first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the humanshape egg groups.

It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters. When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat. It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles. When shooting 3,600 degree F fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat. It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters. They dwell in volcanic craters. According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano. From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,500 degrees Fahrenheit. Its arm starts to melt when it fires a whole barrage. There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals. Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey. When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es:
Magmortar es conocido como "Pokémon Explosión", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Magmortar apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo humanshape.

Sus brazos disparan bolas de fuego de más de 2000 °C. Vive en cráteres volcánicos. Sus brazos disparan bolas de fuego de más de 2000 °C. El aliento que desprende es abrasador. Vive en cráteres volcánicos. Al parecer, en cada volcán solo habita una pareja de Magmortar. Expulsa bolas de fuego por los brazos que alcanzan los 2000 °C. Si lanza ráfagas, sus bazos pueden llegar a fundirse un poco. En la actualidad son aún muchas las empresas metalúrgicas que dependen de las llamas de Magmortar para trabajar el metal. Expulsa bolas de fuego con las que arrolla a su enemigo y lo deja completamente chamuscado, razón por la que evita este método al cazar. Al respirar profundamente, el fuego del interior de su vientre gana intensidad y puede alcanzar los 2000 ºC. Al vivir en un cráter, su cuerpo ha adquirido un aspecto similar al de un volcán y ha desarrollado un órgano parecido a una cámara magmática.

name: Togekiss
description:
Togekiss is known as "Jubilee Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as wings.

Togekiss first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the flying, fairy egg groups.

It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently. It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife. As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings. These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all. Known as a bringer of blessings, it’s been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times. Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.
description_es:
Togekiss es conocido como "Pokémon Festejo", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como alas.

Togekiss apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo volador, hada.

Se dice que aparece en zonas pacíficas y las bendice con sus dones. Congenia muy bien con las personas que respetan los derechos de los demás y evitan riñas innecesarias. Este Pokémon jamás se muestra en lugares donde reine la discordia y la disensión. Últimamente apenas se avistan ejemplares. Se dice que es portador de buena suerte. Por ello, su imagen aparece representada en talismanes y amuletos desde la antigüedad.

name: Yanmega
description:
Yanmega is known as "Ogre Darner Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as bug-wings.

Yanmega first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the bug egg groups.

By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes. Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed. This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced. The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight. It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed. Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.
description_es:
Yanmega es conocido como "Pokémon Libélula", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como alas de insecto.

Yanmega apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo bicho.

Su técnica favorita consiste en volar a gran velocidad y despedazar con su mandíbula a su oponente en un instante. Con sus seis patas puede llevar a un adulto y volar con comodidad. Se equilibra con las alas de su cola.

name: Leafeon
description:
Leafeon is known as "Verdant Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Leafeon first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air. It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis. When you see LEAFEON asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air. With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air. When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air. Its cellular composition is closer to that of a plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to produce its energy supply without eating food. The younger they are, the more they smell like fresh grass. With age, their fragrance takes on the odor of fallen leaves. Although it doesn’t like disputes, it will sharpen the leaf on its tail into a blade and fight if it has to protect its friends. It gets its nutrition from photosynthesis. It lives a quiet life deep in forests where clean rivers flow. Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts from this Pokémon’s leaves. There’s a popular perfume made using that scent.
description_es:
Leafeon es conocido como "Pokémon Verdor", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Leafeon apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

En días soleados duerme y hace la fotosíntesis, emitiendo aire puro a su alrededor. Al igual que una planta, hace la fotosíntesis. Como consecuencia, siempre está rodeado de aire puro. Su estructura celular se asemeja más a la de las plantas que a la de los animales. Puede obtener energía sin alimentos gracias a la fotosíntesis. Los Leafeon jóvenes desprenden un intenso aroma a hierba fresca, mientras que el olor de los mayores es más semejante a la hojarasca. A pesar de evitar a toda costa los combates, si ha de proteger a sus amigos, no duda en usar la hoja de la cola como una afilada espada. Realiza la fotosíntesis para obtener nutrientes. Habita en la apacible espesura de los bosques bañados por arroyos de agua cristalina. El peculiar aroma que desprenden sus hojas es muy apreciado por los habitantes de Galar y se usa en la elaboración de codiciados perfumes. Se siente muy orgulloso de su cola afilada como una espada, con la que es capaz de cortar en dos el tronco de un árbol grueso.

name: Glaceon
description:
Glaceon is known as "Fresh Snow Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Glaceon first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles. By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry. It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere. It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire. It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust. It freezes its fur into icicles, spiky and sharp, and tackles its prey. It protects itself by freezing its fur into sharp needles. It can drop its body temperature below –75 degrees Fahrenheit. It can instantaneously freeze any moisture that’s around it, creating ice pellets to shoot at its prey. Any who become captivated by the beauty of the snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozen before they know it. The coldness emanating from Glaceon causes powdery snow to form, making it quite a popular Pokémon at ski resorts.
description_es:
Glaceon es conocido como "Pokémon Nieve Fresca", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Glaceon apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Controla su temperatura corporal para congelar el ambiente y causar ráfagas de nieve en polvo. Al reducir su temperatura corporal, su pelaje se congela y se convierte en afilados pinchos que puede disparar. Controla a su antojo la temperatura corporal y congela las partículas de agua que flotan en el aire para provocar ráfagas de nieve en polvo. Al congelar su pelaje, este se eriza formando carámbanos con los que ataca a su presa en cuanto la avista. Congela su pelaje y lo convierte en afilados pinchos para defenderse. Es capaz de reducir su temperatura corporal hasta -60 ºC. En un solo instante congela las partículas de agua a su alrededor y crea cristales de hielo con los que ataca a su presa. Desprende cristales de hielo. Sus presas se quedan congeladas sin darse cuenta, encandiladas por su belleza. El aire gélido que exhala crea una suerte de cristales de hielo que lo hace muy demandado en las estaciones de esquí.

name: Gliscor
description:
Gliscor is known as "Fang Scorpion Pokémon", predominantly purple in color, with a silhouette classified as wings.

Gliscor first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the bug egg groups.

It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops! If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once. Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest. It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant. It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.
description_es:
Gliscor es conocido como "Pokémon Colmicorpio", de color predominantemente púrpura, con una silueta clasificada como alas.

Gliscor apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo bicho.

Espera a sus presas colgado de una rama bocabajo. Cuando llega su oportunidad, se lanza en picado. Vuela sin hacer nada de ruido. Con su larga cola captura a sus presas y las muerde con sus colmillos.

name: Mamoswine
description:
Mamoswine is known as "Twin Tusk Pokémon", predominantly brown in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Mamoswine first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age. A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement. A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time. It flourished worldwide during the ice age but its population declined when the masses of ice began to dwindle. When the temperature rose at the end of the ice age, most Mamoswine disappeared. A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time. This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct. It looks strong, and that’s exactly what it is. As the weather grows colder, its ice tusks grow longer, thicker, and more impressive. This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.
description_es:
Mamoswine es conocido como "Pokémon Doscolmillos", de color predominantemente marrón, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Mamoswine apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Ya existía en la antigüedad. Se encontró uno bajo hielo de hace más de 10 000 años. Sus impresionantes colmillos están hechos de hielo. Su población se redujo tras la glaciación. Aparece representado en pinturas rupestres de hace 10 000 años. Hubo un tiempo en el que se lo consideró extinto. Es tan fuerte como parece. Cuanto más frío hace, más gruesos, largos e imponentes se vuelven sus colmillos de hielo.

name: Porygon-Z
description:
Porygon-Z is known as "Virtual Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as arms.

Porygon-Z first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the mineral egg groups.

Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however. Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned. Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error... In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly. Its program was modified to facilitate extra-dimensional activities, but that led to noticeably strange behavior. Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming. A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure. Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior. Some say an additional program made this Pokémon evolve, but even academics can’t agree on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution. A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.
description_es:
Porygon-Z es conocido como "Pokémon Virtual", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como brazos.

Porygon-Z apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo mineral.

Se le instaló un software para mejorarlo. Sin embargo, comenzó a comportarse de manera extraña. Aunque le instalaron un software para desplazarse por otras dimensiones, algo no funcionó bien. Se le instaló un software para mejorarlo. Sin embargo, algo salió mal y a raíz de ello comenzó a comportarse de manera extraña. La actualización de software que recibió para viajar a otras dimensiones ha causado cambios extraños y llamativos en su comportamiento. Llama la atención por su errática conducta, la cual se debe a la torpeza de quien realizara la actualización de su sistema operativo. El software que se le instaló era defectuoso. Tal vez se trate de un experimento fallido, a tenor de su extraño comportamiento. Se le instaló un software que le permite entrar y salir de otras dimensiones, pero que provocó que su comportamiento se volviese inestable. Se dice que evolucionó con la instalación de un nuevo software, pero la comunidad científica está dividida respecto a si es o no una evolución.

name: Gallade
description:
Gallade is known as "Blade Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Gallade first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the humanshape, indeterminate egg groups.

A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows. When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely. Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce. True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone. Sharply attuned to others’ wishes for help, this Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them in battle. The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.
description_es:
Gallade es conocido como "Pokémon Cuchilla", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Gallade apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo humanshape, indeterminate.

Puede presentir los movimientos de sus rivales y por eso ataca siempre antes que ellos. Lucha con las espadas que salen de sus codos. Es un maestro de la cortesía y la esgrima. Este Pokémon es considerado todo un justiciero. Solo utiliza las espadas que le salen de los codos si tiene una causa que defender. Es capaz de percibir al instante cuando alguien está en un aprieto y corre raudo a su lado para prestarle ayuda.

name: Probopass
description:
Probopass is known as "Compass Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as heads.

Probopass first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the mineral egg groups.

It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses. It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack the foe from three directions. It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable. The main body controls three mobile units called Mini-Noses, which it maneuvers to catch prey. Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don’t come back. It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders. It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.
description_es:
Probopass es conocido como "Pokémon Brújula", de color predominantemente gris, con una silueta clasificada como cabezas.

Probopass apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo mineral.

Emana un fuerte magnetismo. Controla tres pequeñas unidades llamadas mininarices. Con el magnetismo que emana, controla tres pequeñas unidades llamadas mininarices. Crea un campo magnético tan potente que inutiliza cualquier electrodoméstico que se encuentre cerca. Las tres unidades que controla, llamadas mininarices, le permiten atrapar a su presa sin necesidad de mover el resto de su cuerpo. Manipula unas pequeñas unidades conocidas como mininarices, aunque estas a veces se pierden y no saben cómo regresar a Probopass. Usa sus tres pequeñas unidades para capturar presas o combatir, mientras que el resto de su cuerpo se dedica casi solo a impartir órdenes.

name: Dusknoir
description:
Dusknoir is known as "Gripper Pokémon", predominantly black in color, with a silhouette classified as arms.

Dusknoir first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the indeterminate egg groups.

The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there. It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home. This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it. At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own. With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir swallows its target whole. The soul is the only thing eaten— Dusknoir disgorges the body before departing. Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.
description_es:
Dusknoir es conocido como "Pokémon Grilletes", de color predominantemente negro, con una silueta clasificada como brazos.

Dusknoir apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo indeterminate.

Se dice que recoge en su cuerpo flexible a los espíritus extraviados y los guía hasta casa. La antena de la cabeza capta ondas de otra dimensión que le incitan a llevarse allí a la gente. Se desconoce si posee voluntad propia. Capta ondas de otra dimensión que le incitan a llevarse allí a humanos y Pokémon. Engulle a los rivales con la boca del estómago y, tras haber devorado el alma, escupe el cuerpo.

name: Froslass
description:
Froslass is known as "Snow Land Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as arms.

Froslass first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the fairy, mineral egg groups.

It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow. It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey. Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS. Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow. Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass. When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations. The soul of a woman lost on a snowy mountain possessed an icicle, becoming this Pokémon. The food it most relishes is the souls of men. It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome. It’s said that on nights of terrible blizzards, it comes down to human settlements. If you hear it knocking at your door, do not open it!
description_es:
Froslass es conocido como "Pokémon Tierra Fría", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como brazos.

Froslass apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo hada, mineral.

Congela a sus enemigos con un aliento gélido de -50 °C. Su cuerpo está hueco. Cuenta la leyenda que es la reencarnación de mujeres que sufrieron accidentes en la nieve. Con su gélido aliento congela a todo Pokémon o humano que le llame la atención y se lo lleva a su guarida para usarlo como objeto decorativo. Cuenta la leyenda que es la reencarnación de mujeres que sufrieron accidentes en la nieve. Siente predilección por las almas masculinas. Congela a los hombres que se aventuran en las cimas nevadas y se los lleva a su guarida, pero tan solo a aquellos que considera apuestos. Se dice que aparece de noche en poblaciones tras una intensa ventisca. Si llama a la puerta, no se le debe abrir bajo ningún concepto. Nació del resentimiento de mujeres fallecidas en montañas nevadas. Su manjar predilecto son las almas congeladas. Expulsa un vaho gélido a -50 °C con el que congela a sus presas para luego llevarlas a su morada y colocarlas como adorno.

name: Rotom
description:
Rotom is known as "Plasma Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as ball.

Rotom first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the indeterminate egg groups.

Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc. Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief. Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor. One boy’s invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom’s unique capabilities. With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others. This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
description_es:
Rotom es conocido como "Pokémon Plasma", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como bola.

Rotom apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo indeterminate.

Desde hace mucho tiempo se estudia su singular motor como fuente de energía motriz. Su cuerpo está hecho de plasma. Puede infiltrarse en dispositivos electrónicos e inutilizarlos. Gracias a la inventiva de cierto joven, se ha iniciado la fabricación de diversos artilugios que aprovechan todo el potencial de Rotom. Su cuerpo de plasma le permite infiltrarse en toda clase de dispositivos electrónicos. Adora sobresaltar a la gente.

name: Uxie
description:
Uxie is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Knowledge Pokémon", predominantly yellow in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Uxie first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes. It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life. When UXIE flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge. According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems. When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge. A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.
description_es:
Uxie es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Sabiduría", de color predominantemente amarillo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Uxie apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Se le conoce como el Ser de la Sabiduría. Se dice que puede borrar la memoria con una mirada. Se dice que su aparición otorgó a los humanos la inteligencia para mejorar sus vidas.

name: Mesprit
description:
Mesprit is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Emotion Pokémon", predominantly pink in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Mesprit first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy. It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface. When MESPRIT flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions. This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy. When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions. Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.
description_es:
Mesprit es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Sensorio", de color predominantemente rosa, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Mesprit apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Se le conoce como el Ser de la Emoción. Enseñó a los humanos la nobleza del dolor y la alegría. Duerme en el fondo de un lago. Se dice que su espíritu deja el cuerpo para volar sobre el agua.

name: Azelf
description:
Azelf is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Willpower Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Azelf first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance. It is thought that UXIE, MESPRIT and AZELF all came from the same egg. When AZELF flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower. This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties. When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg. The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.
description_es:
Azelf es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Voluntad", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Azelf apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Se le conoce como el Ser de la Voluntad. Duerme en el fondo de un lago para equilibrar el mundo. Se cree que Uxie, Mesprit y Azelf provienen del mismo huevo.

name: Dialga
description:
Dialga is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Temporal Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Dialga first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity. A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when DIALGA was born. A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA’s heart beats. This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future. A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats. A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born. This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.
description_es:
Dialga es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Temporal", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Dialga apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Un Pokémon de leyenda. Se dice que el tiempo comenzó a avanzar cuando Dialga nació. Tiene el poder de controlar el tiempo. Aparece en los mitos de Sinnoh como una vieja deidad.

name: Palkia
description:
Palkia is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Spatial Pokémon", predominantly purple in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Palkia first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology. It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology. A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA’s every breath. Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions. A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath. This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.
description_es:
Palkia es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Espacial", de color predominantemente púrpura, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Palkia apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Se dice que vive en una dimensión espacial paralela. Aparece en la mitología. Tiene la habilidad de distorsionar el espacio. La mitología de Sinnoh lo describe como una deidad.

name: Heatran
description:
Heatran is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Lava Dome Pokémon", predominantly brown in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Heatran first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls. Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat. Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves. Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.
description_es:
Heatran es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Domo Lava", de color predominantemente marrón, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Heatran apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Habita cuevas volcánicas. Cava con sus pies en forma de cruz para trepar por techos y paredes. Su sangre fluye ardiendo como si fuera magma. Vive en cráteres de volcanes.

name: Regigigas
description:
Regigigas is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Colossal Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Regigigas first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes. It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma. It is believed to have shaped REGIROCK, REGICE, and REGISTEEL out of clay, ice, and magma. All over the world, there are legends that tell of Regigigas creating other Pokémon in its own image. It’s said that Regigigas created other Pokémon from many different materials before it moved the continents to where they are today. According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.
description_es:
Regigigas es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Colosal", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Regigigas apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Se dice que usó rocas, magma y un hielo especial de montaña para crear Pokémon con su aspecto. Una antigua leyenda afirma que este Pokémon arrastraba continentes con cuerdas. Existen leyendas en todo el mundo que narran como Regigigas creó otros Pokémon a su imagen y semejanza. Dicen que creó a otros Pokémon a partir de distintos materiales y que, después, colocó los continentes en su posición actual.

name: Giratina
description:
Giratina is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Renegade Pokémon", predominantly black in color, with a silhouette classified as tentacles.

Giratina first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery. It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World. This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange. There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.
description_es:
Giratina es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Renegado", de color predominantemente negro, con una silueta clasificada como tentáculos.

Giratina apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Vive en el Mundo Distorsión, un mundo opuesto al nuestro y cuyas leyes desafían el sentido común. Fue desterrado por su violencia. Observa el mundo en silencio desde el Mundo Distorsión.

name: Cresselia
description:
Cresselia is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Lunar Pokémon", predominantly yellow in color, with a silhouette classified as squiggle.

Cresselia first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon. On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully. Those who sleep holding CRESSELIA’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon. Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon. Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.
description_es:
Cresselia es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Lunar", de color predominantemente amarillo, con una silueta clasificada como garabato.

Cresselia apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Sus alas emiten un velo de partículas brillantes. Se dice que representa un cuarto lunar. Si alguien se duerme con una pluma suya, tendrá sueños maravillosos. Encarna el creciente lunar.

name: Phione
description:
Phione is a mythical Pokémon, known as "Sea Drifter Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as arms.

Phione first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the water1, fairy egg groups.

It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted. A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food. When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs. Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.
description_es:
Phione es un Pokémon singular, conocido como "Pokémon Marino", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como brazos.

Phione apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo agua 1, hada.

Si sube la temperatura del mar, infla el flotador de su cabeza y flota en grupo en la superficie. Va a la deriva por mares cálidos. Siempre vuelve a donde nació, por mucho que se haya alejado.

name: Manaphy
description:
Manaphy is a mythical Pokémon, known as "Seafaring Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Manaphy first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the water1, fairy egg groups.

Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace. Water makes up 80% of its body. This Pokémon is easily affected by its environment. It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon. It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon. Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.
description_es:
Manaphy es un Pokémon singular, conocido como "Pokémon Náutico", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Manaphy apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo agua 1, hada.

Nace con un maravilloso poder que le permite establecer vínculos con cualquier tipo de Pokémon. Posee un poder singular que hace que entable amistad con casi cualquier Pokémon.

name: Darkrai
description:
Darkrai is a mythical Pokémon, known as "Pitch-Black Pokémon", predominantly black in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Darkrai first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon. Folklore has it that on moonless nights, this Pokémon will make people see horrific nightmares. To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm. It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers. On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.
description_es:
Darkrai es un Pokémon singular, conocido como "Pokémon Oscuridad", de color predominantemente negro, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Darkrai apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Defiende su territorio de personas y Pokémon haciéndoles dormir y provocándoles pesadillas. Puede adormecer a la gente y hacerles soñar. Está activo en las noches de luna nueva.

name: Shaymin
description:
Shaymin is a mythical Pokémon, known as "Gratitude Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Shaymin first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant. It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers. The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers. When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.
description_es:
Shaymin es un Pokémon singular, conocido como "Pokémon Gratitud", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Shaymin apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Puede disolver las toxinas del aire para transformar tierra yerma en campos de flores. Se dice que, cuando florecen las Gracídeas, Shaymin alza el vuelo para mostrar su gratitud.

name: Arceus
description:
Arceus is a mythical Pokémon, known as "Alpha Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Arceus first appeared in the generation iv.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms. It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed. It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world. According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world. It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing then shaped the world. It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
description_es:
Arceus es un Pokémon singular, conocido como "Pokémon Alfa", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Arceus apareció por primera vez en la generation iv.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Según la mitología de Sinnoh, Arceus surgió de un huevo y después creó todo el mundo. La mitología cuenta que este Pokémon nació antes de que el Universo existiera.

name: Victini
description:
Victini is a mythical Pokémon, known as "Victory Pokémon", predominantly yellow in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Victini first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter. It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it. When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.
description_es:
Victini es un Pokémon singular, conocido como "Pokémon Victoria", de color predominantemente amarillo, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Victini apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Pokémon que atrae la victoria. Dicen que el Entrenador que lo lleve saldrá vencedor de cualquier batalla. Cuando Victini comparte su energía ilimitada, esa persona o Pokémon irradia abundante poder.

name: Snivy
description:
Snivy is known as "Grass Snake Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Snivy first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground, plant egg groups.

It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter. They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop. Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
description_es:
Snivy es conocido como "Pokémon Serp. Hierba", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Snivy apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground, plant.

Cuando recibe los rayos de sol, se mueve mucho más rápido que de costumbre. Usa mejor sus lianas que sus manos. Sintetiza la luz del sol que recoge con su cola. Esta se le queda abatida cuando le fallan las energías.

name: Servine
description:
Servine is known as "Grass Snake Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Servine first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground, plant egg groups.

It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques. When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
description_es:
Servine es conocido como "Pokémon Serp. Hierba", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Servine apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground, plant.

Parece que se desliza al correr. Engaña a sus rivales con su velocidad y los fustiga con su látigo. Cuando su cuerpo está sucio, no puede realizar la fotosíntesis con sus hojas, así que cuida mucho su higiene personal.

name: Serperior
description:
Serperior is known as "Regal Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as squiggle.

Serperior first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground, plant egg groups.

It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally. They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent. It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
description_es:
Serperior es conocido como "Pokémon Realeza", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como garabato.

Serperior apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground, plant.

Tan solo muestra su verdadero poder a quienes no se amedrentan ante su noble pero inquisitoria mirada. Detiene los movimientos del rival con una sola mirada. Expande la energía solar dentro de su cuerpo.

name: Tepig
description:
Tepig is known as "Fire Pig Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Tepig first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them. It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead. It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
description_es:
Tepig es conocido como "Pokémon Cerdo Fuego", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Tepig apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Evita con agilidad los ataques enemigos. Lanza bolas de fuego por su hocico y tuesta bayas del bosque para comer. Le encanta comer bayas tostadas, pero a veces se emociona demasiado y termina churruscándolas.

name: Pignite
description:
Pignite is known as "Fire Pig Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Pignite first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke. Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases. The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
description_es:
Pignite es conocido como "Pokémon Cerdo Fuego", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Pignite apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Cuanto más come, más combustible tiene en su interior para avivar sus llamas, con lo que también aumenta su poder. Cuando las llamas de su interior se avivan, aumenta su velocidad y agilidad. Emite humo si está en peligro.

name: Emboar
description:
Emboar is known as "Mega Fire Pig Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Emboar first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends. It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire. A flaring beard of fire is proof that it is fired up. It is adept at using many different moves.
description_es:
Emboar es conocido como "Pokémon Cerdo Ígneo", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Emboar apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Calienta sus puños con las llamas de su barbilla para propinar puñetazos ardientes. Es muy fiel a sus compañeros. Posee una tupida barba fogosa. Es tanto rápido como poderoso, y su principal baza es la lucha cuerpo a cuerpo.

name: Oshawott
description:
Oshawott is known as "Sea Otter Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Oshawott first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing. The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade. The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well. The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle—it can be used to break open hard berries as well. This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.
description_es:
Oshawott es conocido como "Pokémon Nutria", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Oshawott apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

La vieira de su ombligo no solo sirve como arma, sino también como instrumento para cortar las bayas que estén duras. Ataca con la vieira de su ombligo. En cuanto para un ataque, pasa al contraataque sin dilación.

name: Dewott
description:
Dewott is known as "Discipline Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Dewott first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops. As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops. Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
description_es:
Dewott es conocido como "Pokémon Superación", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Dewott apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Gran espadachín. Utiliza sus dos vieiras con soltura al ejecutar las técnicas que aprende con una disciplina espartana. Tras un exhaustivo entrenamiento, Dewott puede dominar diversas técnicas para usar con sus vieiras.

name: Samurott
description:
Samurott is known as "Formidable Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Samurott first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody. Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies. In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs. Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
description_es:
Samurott es conocido como "Pokémon Majestuoso", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Samurott apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

En un abrir y cerrar de ojos, puede desenvainar y envainar los sables que hay en sus patas delanteras. Derriba a su rival con un solo tajo del sable que lleva en su coraza. Acalla al enemigo con una simple mirada.

name: Patrat
description:
Patrat is known as "Scout Pokémon", predominantly brown in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Patrat first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others. Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout. Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
description_es:
Patrat es conocido como "Pokémon Explorador", de color predominantemente marrón, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Patrat apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Almacena víveres en unas bolsas en sus mofletes y vigila durante días. Hace señales con la cola a sus compañeros. Aunque es un Pokémon muy precavido y siempre hay uno montando guardia, si se acercan por detrás, no se dará cuenta.

name: Watchog
description:
Watchog is known as "Lookout Pokémon", predominantly brown in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Watchog first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches. They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark. Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
description_es:
Watchog es conocido como "Pokémon Alerta", de color predominantemente marrón, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Watchog apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Los componentes luminiscentes de su interior hacen que sus ojos y su cuerpo brillen, y así intimida a sus rivales. Ataca lanzando las semillas de las bayas que acumula en sus mofletes. Su cola se tensa al avistar a un enemigo.

name: Lillipup
description:
Lillipup is known as "Puppy Pokémon", predominantly brown in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Lillipup first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees. The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings. Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle. Because it doesn’t yelp, it’s extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings. The long fur surrounding its face functions as radar, enabling it to probe the condition of its battle opponents. This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can’t defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses. This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it’s intelligent, obedient to its Trainer’s commands, and easy to raise. This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings. This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.
description_es:
Lillipup es conocido como "Pokémon Perrito", de color predominantemente marrón, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Lillipup apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Los mechones que cubren su cara actúan como un magnífico radar para detectar con precisión lo que hay a su alrededor. Aunque se trata de un Pokémon valeroso, también es lo bastante inteligente como para escapar si el rival es muy fuerte. No suele ladrar mucho, por lo que resulta muy popular entre los Entrenadores que viven en apartamentos. Los mechones que le cubren el rostro actúan como un radar con el que averiguan la envergadura de posibles contrincantes. Este Pokémon destaca por su perspicacia. Si percibe que no lleva las de ganar, no duda en huir con el rabo entre las piernas. Este inteligente Pokémon es muy popular, ya que obedece sin rechistar a su Entrenador e incluso los novatos pueden entrenarlo sin problemas. Es valiente pero cauto. Usa el suave pelaje que le recubre el rostro para obtener información sobre su entorno. Muestra una inteligencia muy superior a la media de los niños humanos. No olvida ni el amor ni los malos tratos que recibe.

name: Herdier
description:
Herdier is known as "Loyal Dog Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Herdier first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives. It loyally follows its Trainer’s orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon. This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon. Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train. This Pokémon obeys its master’s orders faithfully. However, it refuses to listen to anything said by a person it doesn’t respect. The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can’t easily penetrate it. It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago. Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people. The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.
description_es:
Herdier es conocido como "Pokémon Leal", de color predominantemente gris, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Herdier apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Este Pokémon es muy leal. No solo ayuda a Entrenadores, sino que también se preocupa por otros Pokémon. Un robusto pelaje cubre su cuerpo a modo de capa y disminuye el daño que recibe en los ataques. El recio y oscuro pelaje que le cubre el lomo crece tan rápido que mantenerlo corto resulta de lo más caro. Obedece sin rechistar las órdenes de su dueño. Ahora bien, ignora sin pudor a todo aquel que considere inferior. Con el paso del tiempo, su oscuro pelaje se vuelve duro y resistente, lo que le sirve como ligera protección contra colmillos y cuernos. Ha convivido mucho tiempo con los humanos, como atestiguan las pinturas rupestres donde aparece representado. Es muy inteligente y cariñoso. Existen ciertas teorías que lo consideran el primer Pokémon que se convirtió en compañero de los humanos. El pelaje negro que lo recubre es tan denso y elástico que puede repeler incluso los colmillos más afilados.

name: Stoutland
description:
Stoutland is known as "Big-Hearted Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Stoutland first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold. This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains. Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain. Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it’s a trustworthy partner on rescue teams. With this wise Pokémon, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit. It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable. Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland. These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days. Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.
description_es:
Stoutland es conocido como "Pokémon Magnánimo", de color predominantemente gris, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Stoutland apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Socorre a humanos perdidos en montañas azotadas por ventiscas. Su largo pelaje le protege del frío. Un humano podría pasar una noche gélida en las montañas sin pasar frío si se tapara con su largo y tupido pelaje. A su inteligencia y carácter afable se suma su valentía. Presta una ayuda inestimable a los equipos de rescate. Debido a su inteligencia y a lo manso que se muestra al tratar con personas, algunos padres confían en él incluso para proteger a sus hijos. El largo y cálido pelaje le permite soportar sin ningún problema el frío, pero resulta un poco asfixiante en Alola. Posee un largo y tupido pelaje. En las regiones frías no había antaño una casa que no tuviese un Stoutland. Parece ser que le gusta vivir con personas. En tan solo tres días ya le coge cariño a cualquiera que lo haya atrapado en estado salvaje. Sus impresionantes bigotes son su orgullo. Entre los de su especie se establece una jerarquía según su longitud.

name: Purrloin
description:
Purrloin is known as "Devious Pokémon", predominantly purple in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Purrloin first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect. Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws. Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces. It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit. Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.
description_es:
Purrloin es conocido como "Pokémon Malicioso", de color predominantemente púrpura, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Purrloin apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Distrae a su oponente con movimientos gráciles y sustrae sus pertenencias. Cuando se enfada, ataca con las garras. Hurta a los humanos por mera diversión, pero las víctimas lo perdonan al ver a este Pokémon tan encantador. Sustrae las pertenencias de las personas solo para verlas pasar apuros. Es un rival encarnizado de Nickit. Una vez que ha logrado distraer al rival mediante sus gestos adorables, lo araña de improviso con las garras mientras muestra un semblante risueño.

name: Liepard
description:
Liepard is known as "Cruel Pokémon", predominantly purple in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Liepard first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur. Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react. Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night. Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon. This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.
description_es:
Liepard es conocido como "Pokémon Calculador", de color predominantemente púrpura, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Liepard apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Su bella y grácil silueta le viene dada por su desarrollada musculatura, que le permite andar de noche sin hacer ruido. Se aproxima evitando que lo detecten. Con sigilo, se acerca a su rival por la espalda y lo ataca. Bajo su hermoso pelaje y cautivador estilo, que puede llevar fácilmente a engaño, se oculta un carácter imprevisible y agresivo. Libra disputas territoriales con los Thievul. Se acerca a sus rivales por la espalda sin hacer el menor ruido.

name: Pansage
description:
Pansage is known as "Grass Monkey Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Pansage first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic. It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress. It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
description_es:
Pansage es conocido como "Pokémon Mono Hierba", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Pansage apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Comparte las hojas de su cabeza con Pokémon agotados. Posee la facultad de aliviar el cansancio. Es todo un experto en la búsqueda de bayas y es tan gentil que las comparte con todos sus compañeros.

name: Simisage
description:
Simisage is known as "Thorn Monkey Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Simisage first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter. It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered. It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.
description_es:
Simisage es conocido como "Pokémon Mono Pincho", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Simisage apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Ataca estampando las espinas de su cola en el enemigo. Es un Pokémon con mucho temperamento. Pokémon muy temperamental que lucha con su cola revestida de púas. Las hojas de su cabeza están muy amargas.

name: Pansear
description:
Pansear is known as "High Temp Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Pansear first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries. This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F. Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people. This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es:
Pansear es conocido como "Pokémon Ardiente", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Pansear apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Pokémon muy inteligente que tiene la costumbre de tostar las bayas antes de comérselas. Ayuda mucho a los humanos. Vive en cuevas volcánicas. El interior de su mata de pelo arde, llegando a alcanzar hasta 300 °C.

name: Simisear
description:
Simisear is known as "Ember Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Simisear first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body. A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents. When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
description_es:
Simisear es conocido como "Pokémon Lumbre", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Simisear apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Achicharra a sus enemigos desprendiendo llamas por la cola y la cabeza, fruto de su desmesurado calor interno. Cuando se emociona, echa chispas por la cola y la cabeza, y calienta su cuerpo. Por alguna razón le encantan los dulces.

name: Panpour
description:
Panpour is known as "Spray Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Panpour first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large. It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail. The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
description_es:
Panpour es conocido como "Pokémon Salpicadura", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Panpour apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

El agua acumulada en su mata de pelo es rica en nutrientes. Usa su cola para regar plantas con esa misma agua. La acuosidad que acumula en su mata de pelo es rica en nutrientes, ideal para regar plantas y que crezcan mucho.

name: Simipour
description:
Simipour is known as "Geyser Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Simipour first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail. The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
description_es:
Simipour es conocido como "Pokémon Drenaje", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Simipour apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Cuando lanza agua a alta presión con su cola, puede incluso resquebrajar una pared de cemento. Le encantan los lugares con agua limpia. Cuando desciende el nivel de agua de su pelo, se abastece a través de su cola.

name: Munna
description:
Munna is known as "Dream Eater Pokémon", predominantly pink in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Munna first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about. It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist. This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams. Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow. It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.
description_es:
Munna es conocido como "Pokémon Comesueños", de color predominantemente rosa, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Munna apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Cuando un humano o un Pokémon sufre una pesadilla, Munna se aparece ante ellos y la engulle. Se alimenta de los sueños de humanos y Pokémon. Si los sueños son felices, despide humo rosa. Aparece en plena noche junto a la almohada de la gente. Cuando devora los sueños, los motivos de su cuerpo emiten una luz tenue. El humo que despide cambia de color en función del sueño que haya consumido. Si es alegre, será rosa, o negruzco en el caso de una pesadilla.

name: Musharna
description:
Musharna is known as "Drowsing Pokémon", predominantly pink in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Musharna first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon. With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten. The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten. When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality. It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.
description_es:
Musharna es conocido como "Pokémon Duermevela", de color predominantemente rosa, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Musharna apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Multitud de sueños de humanos y Pokémon se encuentran atrapados en el humo que despide por su frente. El color del humo que despide por su abultada frente varía según el contenido de los sueños que haya engullido. Cuando el humo que desprende es de un color negruzco, conviene no acercarse, ya que puede hacer realidad las pesadillas. Siempre está soñando o adormecido. Se pone de muy mal humor al despertar, por lo que es mejor no perturbarlo.

name: Pidove
description:
Pidove is known as "Tiny Pigeon Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as wings.

Pidove first appeared in the generation v.

Belongs to the flying egg groups.

Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands. These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas. This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one. Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you’re scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once. It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.
description_es:
Pidove es conocido como "Pokémon Pichón", de color predominantemente gris, con una silueta clasificada como alas.

Pidove apareció por primera vez en la generation v.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo volador.

Es un Pokémon muy despistado. Aunque reciba órdenes de su Entrenador, se le olvidan, y se queda esperando. Vive en la ciudad, pues se lleva muy bien con la gente. Le encantan los parques y las plazas, donde se reúne con otros. Aparece en lugares habitados por humanos. Conviene tener cuidado al darles de comer, ya que esto podría atraer a cientos de ejemplares. Es muy olvidadizo y no demasiado avispado, pero muchos Entrenadores le tienen simpatía por su carácter afable y sincero.

name: Tranquill
description:
