La robustez de su tren inferior lo hacía invencible en la antigüedad, pero se extinguió tras comerse todas las plantas de las que se nutría. Produce electricidad con la robusta musculatura de la cola. El tamaño de la parte superior del cuerpo palidece en comparación con la inferior.

name: Arctozolt
description:
Arctozolt is known as "Fossil Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Arctozolt first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around. This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
description_es:
Arctozolt es conocido como "Pokémon Fósil", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Arctozolt apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

La parte superior del cuerpo está congelada y, al temblar, genera electricidad. Camina con suma dificultad. Antiguamente vivía en el mar y usaba el hielo del cuerpo para conservar los alimentos. Su extrema lentitud, sin embargo, lo condenó a la extinción.

name: Dracovish
description:
Dracovish is known as "Fossil Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as legs.

Dracovish first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction. Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
description_es:
Dracovish es conocido como "Pokémon Fósil", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como piernas.

Dracovish apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Su excelente capacidad motriz y la fuerza de su mandíbula lo hacían antaño invencible, pero dar caza a todas sus presas propició su extinción. Exhibe con orgullo su inmensa capacidad motriz, que le permite superar los 60 km/h, pero solo puede respirar bajo el agua.

name: Arctovish
description:
Arctovish is known as "Fossil Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as fish.

Arctovish first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head. The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
description_es:
Arctovish es conocido como "Pokémon Fósil", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como pez.

Arctovish apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Atrapa a sus presas congelando su entorno, pero la ubicación de la boca encima de la cabeza le genera dificultades para deglutirlas. Aunque la piel de su rostro era capaz de resistir cualquier ataque, su dificultad para respirar acabó provocando su extinción.

name: Duraludon
description:
Duraludon is known as "Alloy Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Duraludon first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the mineral, dragon egg groups.

Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily. The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
description_es:
Duraludon es conocido como "Pokémon Aleación", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Duraludon apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo mineral, dragón.

Su cuerpo, similar a un metal pulido, es tan ligero como robusto. Sin embargo, tiene el defecto de que se oxida con facilidad. Hace gala de una agilidad extraordinaria, ya que su cuerpo está compuesto de un metal especial. Detesta la lluvia, por lo que habita en cuevas.

name: Dreepy
description:
Dreepy is known as "Lingering Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as squiggle.

Dreepy first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the indeterminate, dragon egg groups.

After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas. If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
description_es:
Dreepy es conocido como "Pokémon Resentido", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como garabato.

Dreepy apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo indeterminate, dragón.

Habitaba los mares en tiempos inmemoriales. Ha revivido en forma de Pokémon de tipo Fantasma para vagar por su antigua morada. En solitario es tan débil que no sería rival ni para un niño, pero, al entrenarse con sus congéneres, evoluciona y se vuelve más fuerte.

name: Drakloak
description:
Drakloak is known as "Caretaker Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as arms.

Drakloak first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the indeterminate, dragon egg groups.

It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve. Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
description_es:
Drakloak es conocido como "Pokémon Cuidador", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como brazos.

Drakloak apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo indeterminate, dragón.

Vuela a una velocidad de 200 km/h. Lucha junto a un Dreepy, al que cuida hasta el momento de su evolución. Si no lleva un Dreepy del que cuidar encima de la cabeza, se intranquiliza y trata de sustituirlo con otro Pokémon.

name: Dragapult
description:
Dragapult is known as "Stealth Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Dragapult first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the indeterminate, dragon egg groups.

When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles. Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
description_es:
Dragapult es conocido como "Pokémon Furtivo", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Dragapult apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo indeterminate, dragón.

Vive en compañía de Dreepy, a los que hospeda en el interior de sus cuernos. Los dispara a velocidad supersónica en combate. Al parecer, los Dreepy que residen en sus cuernos esperan con ilusión el momento de ser propulsados a velocidad supersónica.

name: Zacian
description:
Zacian is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Warrior Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Zacian first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle. This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.
description_es:
Zacian es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Guerrero", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Zacian apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Este Pokémon está considerado como un héroe de leyenda. Absorbe el metal para transformarlo y emplearlo como armamento. Hay quien lo considera una suerte de figura fraterna a la par que rival de Zamazenta, un Pokémon sumido en un profundo letargo.

name: Zamazenta
description:
Zamazenta is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Warrior Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Zamazenta first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle. This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
description_es:
Zamazenta es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Guerrero", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Zamazenta apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Este Pokémon se erigió en salvador de Galar, tras unir fuerzas con un rey de los hombres. Absorbe el metal para utilizarlo en combate. Con la apariencia de una estatua de piedra, este Pokémon se sumió en un letargo tan profundo que acabó cayendo en el olvido.

name: Eternatus
description:
Eternatus is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Gigantic Pokémon", predominantly purple in color, with a silhouette classified as wings.

Eternatus first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active. It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
description_es:
Eternatus es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Gigantesco", de color predominantemente púrpura, con una silueta clasificada como alas.

Eternatus apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Se alimenta de la energía que brota de la tierra de Galar absorbiéndola por el núcleo del pecho. Fue hallado en el interior de un meteorito caído hace 20 000 años. Por lo visto, está relacionado con el misterio que rodea al fenómeno Dinamax.

name: Kubfu
description:
Kubfu is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Wushu Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Kubfu first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves. If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
description_es:
Kubfu es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Kung-fu", de color predominantemente gris, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Kubfu apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Perfecciona su técnica mediante una estricta disciplina. Según la corriente marcial que siga, adoptará una forma u otra al evolucionar. Al tirar de los mechones blancos de la cabeza, acrecienta su espíritu luchador y empieza a acumular fuerza en el órgano de su bajo vientre.

name: Urshifu
description:
Urshifu is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Wushu Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Urshifu first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist. Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
description_es:
Urshifu es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Kung-fu", de color predominantemente gris, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Urshifu apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Su estilo de lucha se basa en abatir a sus rivales de un solo golpe. Se abalanza sobre ellos con su puño cincelado por el entrenamiento. Vive en zonas montañosas en áreas recónditas, donde entrena corriendo por escarpados riscos para fortalecer sus piernas y refinar su técnica.

name: Zarude
description:
Zarude is a mythical Pokémon, known as "Rogue Monkey Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Zarude first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it. Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
description_es:
Zarude es un Pokémon singular, conocido como "Pokémon Simiestro", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Zarude apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Viven en manada en la selva. Debido a su marcada agresividad, son muy temidos por otros Pokémon selváticos. Las lianas que le brotan del cuerpo nutren y fertilizan el mantillo del bosque cuando se le desprenden.

name: Regieleki
description:
Regieleki is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Electron Pokémon", predominantly yellow in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Regieleki first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power. Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.
description_es:
Regieleki es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Electrón", de color predominantemente amarillo, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Regieleki apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Su cuerpo entero es energía eléctrica. Por lo visto, quitarle los anillos que lleva libera su poder oculto. Todo su cuerpo es un órgano electrógeno, cuya potencia sería suficiente para abastecer la región de Galar por completo.

name: Regidrago
description:
Regidrago is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Dragon Orb Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Regidrago first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven. Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
description_es:
Regidrago es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Dragosfera", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Regidrago apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Cierta teoría afirma que la forma de sus brazos representa la cabeza de un Pokémon dragón ancestral, aunque esto no ha podido verificarse. Todo su cuerpo es una gema de energía dragón cristalizada. Se cree que posee los poderes de todos los Pokémon dragón.

name: Glastrier
description:
Glastrier is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Wild Horse Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Glastrier first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force. Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
description_es:
Glastrier es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Corcel Feroz", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Glastrier apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Libera un potente vaho gélido por las pezuñas. Un ser violento que no duda en tomar a la fuerza todo cuanto desea. Cuenta con una fuerza física sobrecogedora. La máscara de hielo que le cubre el rostro es cien veces más dura que el diamante.

name: Spectrier
description:
Spectrier is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Swift Horse Pokémon", predominantly black in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Spectrier first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body. As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
description_es:
Spectrier es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Corcel Veloz", de color predominantemente negro, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Spectrier apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Examina su entorno con todos los sentidos, salvo la vista. Se dice que sus coces son capaces de robarle el alma a quien las recibe. Amante de la quietud y la soledad, galopa por las tinieblas nocturnas absorbiendo la energía vital de toda criatura que esté durmiendo.

name: Calyrex
description:
Calyrex is a legendary Pokémon, known as "King Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Calyrex first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore. Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
description_es:
Calyrex es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Pokémon Rey", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como humanoide.

Calyrex apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

Un Pokémon muy compasivo agraciado con el poder de la curación. Reinó en Galar en tiempos remotos. Legendario monarca del antiguo Galar. Posee el poder de sanar el espíritu y de hacer brotar la vegetación.

name: Wyrdeer
description:
Wyrdeer is known as "Big Horn Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Wyrdeer first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
description_es:
Wyrdeer es conocido como "Big Horn Pokémon", de color predominantemente gris, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Wyrdeer apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Kleavor
description:
Kleavor is known as "Axe Pokémon", predominantly brown in color, with a silhouette classified as bug-wings.

Kleavor first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the bug egg groups.

A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
description_es:
Kleavor es conocido como "Axe Pokémon", de color predominantemente marrón, con una silueta clasificada como alas de insecto.

Kleavor apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo bicho.

A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Ursaluna
description:
Ursaluna is known as "Peat Pokémon", predominantly brown in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Ursaluna first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
description_es:
Ursaluna es conocido como "Peat Pokémon", de color predominantemente marrón, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Ursaluna apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Basculegion
description:
Basculegion is known as "Big Fish Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as fish.

Basculegion first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the water2 egg groups.

Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
description_es:
Basculegion es conocido como "Big Fish Pokémon", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como pez.

Basculegion apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo agua 2.

Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Sneasler
description:
Sneasler is known as "Free Climb Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Sneasler first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
description_es:
Sneasler es conocido como "Free Climb Pokémon", de color predominantemente gris, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Sneasler apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Overqwil
description:
Overqwil is known as "Pin Cluster Pokémon", predominantly black in color, with a silhouette classified as fish.

Overqwil first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the water2 egg groups.

Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
description_es:
Overqwil es conocido como "Pin Cluster Pokémon", de color predominantemente negro, con una silueta clasificada como pez.

Overqwil apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo agua 2.

Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Enamorus
description:
Enamorus is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Love-Hate Pokémon", predominantly pink in color, with a silhouette classified as arms.

Enamorus first appeared in the generation viii.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
description_es:
Enamorus es un Pokémon legendario, conocido como "Love-Hate Pokémon", de color predominantemente rosa, con una silueta clasificada como brazos.

Enamorus apareció por primera vez en la generation viii.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo sin huevos.

When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Sprigatito
description:
Sprigatito is known as "Grass Cat Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Sprigatito first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the ground, plant egg groups.

Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out. The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
description_es:
Sprigatito es conocido como "Grass Cat Pokémon", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Sprigatito apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground, plant.

Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out. The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Floragato
description:
Floragato is known as "Grass Cat Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Floragato first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the ground, plant egg groups.

Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents. The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
description_es:
Floragato es conocido como "Grass Cat Pokémon", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Floragato apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground, plant.

Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents. The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Meowscarada
description:
Meowscarada is known as "Magician Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Meowscarada first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the ground, plant egg groups.

This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating. With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.
description_es:
Meowscarada es conocido como "Magician Pokémon", de color predominantemente verde, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Meowscarada apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground, plant.

This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating. With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

name: Fuecoco
description:
Fuecoco is known as "Fire Croc Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Fuecoco first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy. Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.
description_es:
Fuecoco es conocido como "Fire Croc Pokémon", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Fuecoco apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy. Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

name: Crocalor
description:
Crocalor is known as "Fire Croc Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Crocalor first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head. The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
description_es:
Crocalor es conocido como "Fire Croc Pokémon", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Crocalor apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head. The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Skeledirge
description:
Skeledirge is known as "Singer Pokémon", predominantly red in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Skeledirge first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul. Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_es:
Skeledirge es conocido como "Singer Pokémon", de color predominantemente rojo, con una silueta clasificada como cuadrúpedo.

Skeledirge apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo ground.

The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul. Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Quaxly
description:
Quaxly is known as "Duckling Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Quaxly first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the flying, water1 egg groups.

This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime. Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
description_es:
Quaxly es conocido como "Duckling Pokémon", de color predominantemente blanco, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Quaxly apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo volador, agua 1.

This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime. Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Quaxwell
description:
Quaxwell is known as "Practicing Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Quaxwell first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the flying, water1 egg groups.

These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully. The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
description_es:
Quaxwell es conocido como "Practicing Pokémon", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Quaxwell apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo volador, agua 1.

These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully. The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Quaquaval
description:
Quaquaval is known as "Dancer Pokémon", predominantly blue in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Quaquaval first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the flying, water1 egg groups.

A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands. Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
description_es:
Quaquaval es conocido como "Dancer Pokémon", de color predominantemente azul, con una silueta clasificada como erguido.

Quaquaval apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo volador, agua 1.

A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands. Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

name: Lechonk
description:
Lechonk is known as "Hog Pokémon", predominantly gray in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Lechonk first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the ground egg groups.

It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging. This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

Dipplin apareció por primera vez en la generation ix.

Pertenece a los grupos huevo plant, dragón.

Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place. The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Poltchageist
description:
Poltchageist is known as "Matcha Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as ball.

Poltchageist first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the mineral, indeterminate egg groups.

Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon. Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
description:
Sinistcha is known as "Matcha Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as ball.

Sinistcha first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the mineral, indeterminate egg groups.

It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful. It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Okidogi
description:
Okidogi is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Retainer Pokémon", predominantly black in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Okidogi first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique. Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Munkidori
description:
Munkidori is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Retainer Pokémon", predominantly black in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Munkidori first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom. Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body. Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

name: Ogerpon
description:
Ogerpon is a legendary Pokémon, known as "Mask Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as humanoid.

Ogerpon first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks. This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Archaludon
description:
Archaludon is known as "Alloy Pokémon", predominantly white in color, with a silhouette classified as upright.

Archaludon first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the mineral, dragon egg groups.

It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful. It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

description:
Hydrapple is known as "Apple Hydra Pokémon", predominantly green in color, with a silhouette classified as heads.

Hydrapple first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the plant, dragon egg groups.

Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander. These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

description:
Gouging Fire is known as "Paradox Pokémon", predominantly brown in color, with a silhouette classified as quadruped.

Gouging Fire first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame. It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

Terapagos first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon. It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

description:
Pecharunt is a mythical Pokémon, known as "Subjugation Pokémon", predominantly purple in color, with a silhouette classified as ball.

Pecharunt first appeared in the generation ix.

Belongs to the no-eggs egg groups.

It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will. Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
